## 3.2 httpx2 and pytest-asyncio, for tests of the app {#step-03.2}

FastAPI's [`TestClient`](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/testing/) sends requests to the app in the same
process, with no server. It needs [httpx2](https://github.com/pydantic/httpx2), a library that sends HTTP requests.
One test of the app is a coroutine, an `async` function. pytest cannot run an `async` function by itself, so
[pytest-asyncio](https://pytest-asyncio.readthedocs.io/) runs it.

This change came from running `uv add --group test httpx2 pytest-asyncio`.

The command adds both packages to the group `test`, and writes their versions into `uv.lock`.

```bash
just test -q
```

pytest still prints `11 passed`. The new packages change no test.

### What changed {#step-03.2-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-03.2-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: httpx2 and pytest-asyncio, in the group `test`. 2 lines added. It comes from `uv add --group test httpx2 pytest-asyncio`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/3c75ffb1a089431a2455a69e9bcb3ec0302224f0/pyproject.toml){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `"httpx2>=2.13.1",`
- <a id="step-03.2-uv.lock-8356d8"></a>`uv.lock`: the exact versions of httpx2, pytest-asyncio, and the packages that they need. 68 lines added, 1 removed. It comes from `uv add --group test httpx2 pytest-asyncio`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/3c75ffb1a089431a2455a69e9bcb3ec0302224f0/uv.lock){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

```diff
 [dependency-groups]
 test = [
+    "httpx2>=2.13.1",

+    "pytest-asyncio>=1.4.0",
 ]
 
 [tool.pytest.ini_options]
```
